//: Tracked source of truth for the opencode permission surface the overnight feature-pipeline needs (docs/pipeline/setup.md §4, docs/pipeline/design.md). Merge the `permission` block into each pipeline host's ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json — do NOT symlink this file over it, the host file also carries provider/plugin/model config that is deliberately host-local and out of git. Keeping the allowlist here means the Pi and hp-server transcribe from one place instead of drifting (they already did: ~/.cache/uv/** was live on the Pi and absent from the docs). The `bash` block: Unattended agents must never land their own PRs (issue #180): a human merges. Last match wins, so the catch-all comes first; an unmatched command must not fall to `ask`, a headless agent would hang on the prompt. Copy the same block into every `agent.<name>.permission` on the host, since agent rules take precedence over this one. A speed bump, not a boundary: curl with the token still works (see #199).
